# .json — Viết cho Sài Gòn của t | Project board v0.1

## Open the board

1. Extract this ZIP to a normal folder.
2. Double-click **PROJECT_BOARD.html**. It runs fully offline and shows the selected illustrated cover concept.
3. Scroll to **05 / Live chapter checklist** to search/filter all 75 tasks.
4. Change statuses as production proceeds; changes are saved **only in this browser on this device**.
5. Use **EXPORT MY PROGRESS (.CSV)** to send or commit your updated task statuses. Browser storage is not synchronized with GitHub.

## Files
- `PROJECT_BOARD.html` — interactive, illustrated offline project board.
- `docs/PROJECT_BOARD.md` — detailed literary and media production specification with all 75 tasks and acceptance criteria.
- `docs/ART_DIRECTION.md` — chosen print-inspired color and visual direction.
- `data/tasks.json`, `data/CHECKLIST.csv` — machine-readable tasks.
- `assets/saigon_landmark_poster_proof.png` — preferred stylized **private** concept based on user-supplied photographs.
- `assets/saigon_landmark_poster_proof.jpg` — optimized concept for offline board display.
- `assets/saigon_cover_mock.svg` — anonymous, original vector placeholder for the **public repo**.
- `assets/desktop_preview.png`, `assets/mobile_preview.png` — QA render previews.

## GitHub
- Draft PR: https://github.com/jasonthedataguy/json-under-revision/pull/5
- The PR contains the HTML board, Markdown specification, JSON/CSV ledger and non-identifying SVG fallback. It does **not** contain the original photos or the chosen portrait-inspired poster.

## Release gate
The chapter manuscript identifies real people and employers, and includes personal relationship disclosures. Public prose, photographs and identifiable portrait-derived art require separate author/third-party privacy clearance. Design approval is not release approval.

**Current status:** preproduction board only. No new chapter PDF, video or live Saigon microsite is claimed to have been built.
